استبحرن (form X)
# اِسْتَبْحَرْنَ (istabḥarna) /is.tab.ħar.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَبْحَرَ (istabḥara)
# اِسْتَبْحِرْنَ (istabḥirna) /is.tab.ħir.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَبْحَرَ (istabḥara)
